primarySources.facts: Text-first import, 15 significant digits for worksheet numbers, supported Microsoft 365/2024 automatic conversion options, custom-format and recovery limits.
Windows File/Options/Data; Mac Excel/Preferences/Edit; disable zero/long-number conversions; settings do not directly control Power Query.
CSV uses default import interpretation, explicit delimiter selection, legacy text import option, one worksheet per text export and global separator side effects.
Transform Data; disable detection to default columns to Text; file origin/BOM for encoding; host-specific capabilities.
Automatic first-200-row detection and Changed Type; explicit column types; Int64 is not the same as worksheet number precision; locale and fixed decimal.
Windows legacy wizard enablement; Step 3 Text column format before import.
Known-width zero padding returns text; formatting does not infer missing identifier width.
CSV quoting escapes field delimiters/quotes/newlines, not workbook types.
JSON leading-zero number grammar forbidden; string identifiers; numeric parser precision interoperability.
Formula-like CSV data risks; quote/prefix mitigations are consumer-specific and may fail after save/reopen; no universal sanitization guarantee.
